title: Building My Community Connections

learn_title: Local knowledge is a real asset
insight: Knowing your county is a survival skill.

title: Accessing Food Resources
problem: Food runs short before the money comes back.
learn_title: Food help is a system, not charity
insight: Apply before you're empty, not after.

title: Getting Healthcare Support
problem: You've put off medical stuff for years and don't know where to start.
insight: One appointment is the doorway to the rest.

title: Finding Stable Housing
problem: You don't have a stable place, or the one you have won't last.
learn_title: Housing runs on paperwork and lead time
insight: Start 30 days early and you have options. Start day-of and you have a shelter.

title: Handling Legal Responsibilities
problem: Court dates, fines, probation requirements — it's a lot to keep straight.
learn_title: Missed dates cost more than money
insight: Call before, not after. Every time.

title: Managing Money Basics
problem: Money comes in and disappears before the important stuff is covered.
insight: Pay the things that keep you stable first, same day, every time.

title: Understanding My Benefits
problem: You've heard about benefits but don't know what you qualify for.
insight: Most denials are paperwork, and paperwork can be fixed.

title: Creating My Resource Plan
problem: You've got pieces but no single place they live.
insight: One page beats ten browser tabs on a bad day.

title: Managing Transportation
problem: Getting places is the thing that makes you miss things.
learn_title: Rides break plans more than motivation does
insight: A plan without a ride isn't a plan.

title: Finding Work and Purpose
problem: You need a job and you're worried about your record.
learn_title: The record isn't the whole story
insight: Own it in one sentence, then move to what you bring.

title: The Anger Warning Signs
problem: By the time you notice you're angry, you're already at a 10.
insight: Catch it at a 3 and you still have choices.

title: Choosing My Response
problem: You react, then spend a week fixing what you said.
learn_title: Reaction is fast. Response is chosen.
insight: Ask what you want in an hour, not what you want right now.

title: Communicating When I'm Upset
problem: When you're upset, what comes out isn't what you meant.
insight: Facts, feeling, request. Then listen.

title: Building Emotional Strength
problem: Small things knock you sideways more than they should.
insight: You don't have a temper problem on a full tank.

title: What Happens Before I React
problem: You go from zero to blowing up with nothing in between.
learn_title: There's always a gap — it's just short
insight: You can't stop the spark. You can widen the gap.

title: Managing Conflict
problem: Disagreements turn into fights fast.
learn_title: Conflict isn't the problem — escalation is
insight: You don't have to win it. You have to keep it survivable.

title: Creating My Pause Button
problem: You need something you can actually do in the moment.
insight: A pause is a sentence and a step, decided in advance.

title: Repairing After Conflict
problem: You said something you regret and don't know how to come back.
learn_title: Repair matters more than never messing up
insight: Repair is the skill. Perfect is not available.

title: Responding Instead of Reacting
problem: You want this to be who you are, not something you try once.
insight: Responding isn't a personality. It's a rep count.

title: Understanding My Emotions
problem: You feel something strong but can't say what it is.
insight: Feelings are messengers, not orders.

title: Calming My Mind
problem: Thoughts are racing and you can't get them to stop.
insight: You can't out-think a racing mind. You have to out-breathe it.

title: Creating Safety in My Life
problem: Some places, people, or moments still don't feel safe.
insight: Safety is a picture your body can return to — and a list of places you don't go.

title: Creating My Daily Rhythm
problem: Your days feel shapeless — you drift, then the day is gone.
learn_title: Structure is a nervous system tool
insight: A day with shape is harder for the old life to get into.

title: Finding My Footing
problem: Everything is new and you're not sure where to even start.
insight: You don't build a life from nothing. You build it from what's already holding.

title: Grounding Myself
problem: Heart pounding, muscles tight, can't sit still.
learn_title: Your body is doing its job
insight: Your body listens to your senses faster than it listens to your thoughts.

title: Managing Big Feelings
problem: A feeling hits so hard it takes over the whole day.
insight: Name it to tame it. A feeling you can name is a feeling you can outlast.

title: Managing Overwhelm
problem: Everything piled up and you don't know where to start.
learn_title: Overwhelm is a signal, not a verdict
insight: You don't have to do everything. You have to do the next thing.

title: Managing Worry
problem: Your mind keeps running 'what if' and it never lands anywhere good.
insight: If there's no step, it isn't planning — it's worry wearing a costume.

title: Restoring Healthy Sleep
problem: You can't fall asleep, or you wake up over and over.
insight: You can't force sleep. You can only set the table for it.

title: Building My Stability Plan
problem: Good days happen, but you don't know how to make them repeat.
insight: A plan you wrote yourself is one you'll actually use.

title: Strengthening My Motivation
problem: Some days you can't remember why you're doing this.
learn_title: Motivation is a list, not a mood
insight: You don't need to feel motivated. You need to remember why.

title: Recovering After a Setback
problem: You slipped and it feels like everything's gone.
learn_title: A slip is data, not an identity
insight: One bad day doesn't erase the days behind it.

title: Making Recovery Choices
problem: Small choices add up and you don't always see them happening.
insight: Decide early, where it's cheap.

title: Building My Recovery Support System
problem: You're doing this mostly alone and it's heavy.
insight: Nobody does this alone, and nobody's supposed to.

title: Building My Recovery Toolbox
problem: In the moment you can't remember anything that helps.
learn_title: A toolbox beats memory under pressure
insight: When you can't think, you read.

title: Handling Stress Without Using
problem: Stress builds and using is the only relief you fully trust.
learn_title: You need replacements, not just rules
insight: You don't quit relief. You replace it.

title: Surfing the Craving
problem: You know the craving will pass but you can't get through the middle.
learn_title: The middle is the whole skill
insight: You can't stop the wave. You can stay on the board.

title: Recognizing My Triggers
problem: Triggers keep catching you before you see them coming.
learn_title: Most people have five, not fifty
insight: A trigger you named is a trigger you planned for.

title: Understanding My Cravings
problem: The urge to use hits hard and you don't know what it is.
learn_title: A craving is a message, not a command
insight: A craving is a wave. Waves crest.

title: Becoming the Person I Want to Be
problem: You know what you're moving away from, not what you're moving toward.
insight: Recovery isn't just quitting something. It's becoming someone.

title: Building My Action Plan
problem: You know the steps but the week goes by anyway.
insight: A step without a day is a wish with extra words.

title: Breaking Goals Into Steps
problem: The goal is clear but you still don't start.
learn_title: The first step should feel almost too small
insight: Make step one small enough that skipping it feels silly.

title: Celebrating My Progress
problem: You only notice what you haven't done yet.
learn_title: Counting progress is part of the work
insight: If you don't count the wins, only the losses get recorded.

title: Creating My Future Roadmap
problem: You want a picture of where this all goes.
insight: The future isn't waiting for you. It's being built by what you do today.

title: Setting Goals That Matter
problem: You set goals that sound good and then never touch them.
learn_title: Goals stick when they're yours and they're clear
insight: A goal has a number and a date. Everything else is a wish.

title: Creating Habits That Support My Goals
problem: You do well for a week and then it falls apart.
insight: Don't rely on effort. Build a loop.

title: Creating My Vision for the Future
problem: You've been surviving so long you stopped picturing anything ahead.
learn_title: A picture beats a plan at the start
insight: You can't walk toward something you've never pictured.

title: Preparing for Challenges
problem: Something always comes up and knocks the plan over.
learn_title: Plan for the obstacle, not the perfect week
insight: Decide once, calm. Then just follow it.

title: Staying Motivated When Things Are Hard
problem: Progress is slow and you're losing steam.
insight: On hard days, shrink the goal — never the streak.

title: Building My Personal Success System
problem: You have tools everywhere but nothing that ties them together.
learn_title: A system is your tools in one order
insight: A system is what keeps working when motivation isn't.

title: Asking for Help Is a Strength
problem: You'd rather struggle than ask.
insight: A clear ask is a strength, not a debt.

title: Creating Healthy Boundaries
problem: You either let people run you over or cut them off completely.
learn_title: A boundary is about you, not them
insight: A boundary says what you'll do, not what they can't.

title: Communicating My Needs
problem: You expect people to know what you need, then resent them when they don't.
insight: An unspoken need becomes a resentment.

title: Who Can I Count On?
problem: You're not sure who's actually in your corner.
insight: Two reliable people beat twenty maybes.

title: Handling Difficult Relationships
problem: Some people in your life aren't good for your recovery, but you can't just delete them.
insight: You can't change them. You can change the terms.

title: Giving and Receiving Support
problem: You either give everything away or take without knowing how to accept.
learn_title: Support has to run both ways
insight: Letting someone help you is a gift to them too.

title: Building My Community
problem: You have a few people, but no sense of belonging anywhere.
learn_title: Belonging is built by being useful
insight: You belong to the places you contribute to.

title: Finding Positive Connections
problem: Most people you know are tied to the life you're leaving.
learn_title: New people come from new rooms
insight: New life, new rooms, same face showing up.

title: Building Trust Again
problem: People have reasons not to trust you and you can't rush it.
insight: Trust is a deposit account. Small, repeated, no shortcuts.

title: Creating My Support Plan
problem: On a bad night you don't know who to call first.
learn_title: Write it before you need it
insight: The plan you wrote calm is the plan that works at 2am.

title: Seeing Things Differently
problem: One bad thing colors the whole day.
insight: Zooming out doesn't erase the bad. It stops it from being everything.

title: Building Confidence in My Decisions
problem: You second-guess yourself until you don't decide at all.
learn_title: Good decisions come from a process
insight: Confidence follows a repeatable process, not a good feeling.

title: Thoughts Are Not Always Facts
problem: Your thoughts feel like the truth even when they hurt.
learn_title: Thoughts are guesses your brain makes fast
insight: A thought is a guess, not a verdict.

title: Changing My Inner Voice
problem: The voice in your head talks to you worse than anyone else does.
learn_title: Honest isn't the same as harsh
insight: Talk to yourself like someone you're responsible for.

title: Letting Go of Shame
problem: What you've done feels like who you are.
learn_title: Guilt says 'I did'. Shame says 'I am'.
insight: You are not the worst thing you've done.

title: Building a Resilient Mindset
problem: Setbacks knock you all the way back down.
learn_title: Resilience is a set of habits
insight: Resilience isn't not falling. It's how fast you get back to your routine.

title: Solving Problems Step by Step
problem: The problem is too big and you freeze.
learn_title: Big problems are stacked small ones
insight: You don't solve the problem. You take the next step in it.

title: Catching Thinking Traps
problem: Your brain jumps to the worst version of everything.
insight: Catch the trap and you get your choice back.

title: My Thoughts Won't Stop
problem: Your mind keeps replaying the same thing over and over.
insight: You can't stop a thought. You can stop feeding it.

title: Breaking the Worry Cycle
problem: Worry keeps you up and doesn't change anything.
insight: Give worry a window and it stops taking the whole house.

title: Building Healthy Habits Around Treatment
problem: The medication is one piece, but the rest of the day works against it.
insight: Medication works better with a body that's been fed and rested.

title: Building My Medication Routine
problem: You forget doses, or the timing keeps slipping.
learn_title: Anchor it to something you already do
insight: Don't build willpower. Build a spot on the counter.

title: What If I Miss a Dose?
problem: You missed one and you don't know what to do.
insight: One miss is a miss. Quitting is the only real failure mode.

title: Taking Ownership of My Recovery
problem: It can feel like treatment is something happening to you.
learn_title: You're the one who lives here
insight: Nobody recovers on someone else's plan.

title: Preparing for Appointments
problem: You show up unprepared, or you don't show up at all.
learn_title: The appointment starts the day before
insight: Showing up is a logistics problem, not a character problem.

title: Managing Side Effects
problem: Something about how you feel on this medication isn't right.
insight: A reported side effect can be fixed. A silent one just gets you to quit.

title: Talking With My Provider
problem: Appointments go fast and you leave without saying what mattered.
insight: Bring three things. Say them first.

title: Tracking How I'm Feeling
problem: When your provider asks how it's going, you can't remember.
learn_title: Ten seconds a day beats memory
insight: Data beats memory in the appointment room.

title: Understanding My Treatment Goals
problem: You're in treatment but nobody's said what 'better' looks like.
insight: If the goal isn't yours, the plan won't stick.

title: Why My Medication Matters
problem: You're not sure medication is really doing anything.
insight: Medication doesn't do the work. It makes the work possible.

title: Understanding Anxiety
problem: You feel on edge and can't tell if something's actually wrong.
learn_title: An alarm that goes off too easily
insight: Anxiety is an alarm, not evidence.

title: Understanding Bipolar Disorder
problem: Your moods swing hard and you can't predict them.
insight: You can't control the weather, but you can read the sky.

title: Understanding Depression
problem: Everything feels heavy, flat, or pointless — and you don't know why.
insight: Depression is a symptom set, not a personality.

title: Understanding My Strengths
problem: You can list what's wrong with you faster than what's right.
insight: You're not starting from zero. You're starting from experience.

title: Understanding My Triggers
problem: Something sets you off and you only figure it out afterward.
insight: A trigger you can name is a trigger you can plan around.

title: Understanding Schizophrenia & Psychosis
problem: You've heard or seen things others didn't, or been told you did.
insight: This is a health condition with a treatment plan, not a verdict on who you are.

title: Understanding PTSD & Trauma
problem: Memories or reactions hit you out of nowhere.
insight: It's not happening again. Your body just remembers like it is.

title: Understanding My Recovery Journey
problem: You want to know what recovery actually looks like over time.
learn_title: Recovery is a road, not a switch
insight: Recovery isn't a day you arrive at. It's a direction you keep facing.

title: Understanding Substance Use Disorder
problem: You want to know if this is a choice, a habit, or something else.
learn_title: A learned shortcut, not a character flaw
insight: It's a brain that learned something. Brains can learn something else.

title: Understanding My Treatment Team
problem: There are a lot of names and titles and you're not sure who does what.
insight: You're not a case. You're a member of your own team.

title: Creating My Vision for Life.
problem: What's my vision?
insight: Your vision is a guide built from your values, your future picture, and the steps you'll take.

title: How Can Gratitude Help Me?
problem: Does gratitude actually work?
insight: Gratitude changes your focus by training your brain to see what is good.

title: How Can I Help Other People?
problem: What do I have to give?
insight: Your past experiences give you a unique ability to help others on their own journey.

title: How Do I Believe in Myself Again?
problem: How do I rebuild confidence?
insight: Confidence grows from small actions you take, not from wishing you felt more confident.

title: How Do I Find Peace?
problem: How do I quiet my mind?
learn_title: Practice Peace One Moment at a Time
insight: Peace is something you build through small, consistent actions, not something you discover fully formed.

title: What Am I Good At?
problem: What are my strengths?
insight: Your past survival skills are strengths you can use to build your future.

title: What Does Spiritual Recovery Mean to Me?
problem: Do I need to be religious?
insight: Your spiritual recovery is deeply personal and you get to decide what it means.

title: What Future Am I Building?
problem: Where is this going?
insight: Your future isn't just a dream; it's something you build with today's actions.

title: What Gives My Life Meaning?
problem: Why am I doing this?
insight: Finding meaning in your life helps protect your recovery.

title: What Kind of Person Do I Want to Become?
problem: Who am I becoming?
insight: Your actions today are shaping the person you will become.

title: Building My Stability Plan.
problem: How do I keep it all standing?
learn_title: Four Steps to Your Stability Plan
insight: Building a stable life requires concrete actions with deadlines, not just good intentions.

title: How Do I Find a Job?
problem: Who will hire me?
insight: Fair-chance employers exist, and preparing how you'll discuss your past is key to finding a job.

title: How Do I Get Where I Need to Go?
problem: How do I solve transportation?
learn_title: Plan Your Ride, Keep Your Appointments
insight: Plan your transportation when you schedule your appointment, not when you're walking out the door.

title: How Do I Manage My Money?
problem: How do I stay on top of money?
learn_title: Manage Your Money, Not the Other Way
insight: Plan your money use before cash becomes a problem.

title: How Do I Take Care of My Health?
problem: How do I get healthcare?
insight: Getting your health care set up starts with using the resources available to you.

title: Should I Go Back to School?
problem: Is school worth it for me?
insight: Even short educational programs can open doors and improve your financial situation.

title: What Can I Do Instead of Using?
problem: How do I fill my time well?
insight: Structuring your free time with purpose protects you from relapse.

title: What Kind of Life Do I Want?
problem: What am I building?
insight: Start building your future by clearly imagining what you want and then breaking it into small steps.

title: What Resources Can Help Me?
problem: What's out there for me?
insight: Knowing where to find help for basic needs is a key part of building a stable life.

title: Where Am I Going to Live?
problem: How do I get stable housing?
learn_title: Housing Is Key to Your Recovery
insight: Stable housing is a foundation for your recovery, so prioritize finding it and be ready for appointments.

title: Building My Daily Recovery Plan.
problem: How do I put it all together?
insight: Building a recovery plan helps you manage your day and stay focused on what matters.

title: How Can Exercise Help Me Feel Better?
problem: Do I really have to work out?
learn_title: Moving Your Body Changes Your Mood
insight: Even short bursts of movement can shift your mood and help you feel better.

title: How Can Food Help My Recovery?
problem: What should I eat?
insight: Eating consistently and choosing protein first helps manage cravings by keeping your blood sugar stable.

title: How Do I Break Old Habits?
problem: How do I change a habit?
learn_title: Change Your Habits, Change Your Life
insight: To break a habit, change the routine, keep the reward, and make the old habit harder to do.

title: How Do I Build a Better Daily Routine?
problem: What should my day look like?
insight: Build your routine around consistent anchors each morning, midday, and night.

title: How Do I Calm My Emotions?
problem: How do I settle myself down?
insight: Address strong feelings with simple actions to help them pass.

title: How Do I Have Fun Without Using?
problem: Can life still be fun?
learn_title: Find New Ways to Have Fun
insight: New fun in recovery often feels different at first, but it gets better if you keep trying.

title: What Can I Do Instead of Using?
problem: What fills the space?
insight: Have a plan for filling empty time, even simple activities can make a difference.

title: Why Is Sleep So Important?
problem: Why does sleep matter this much?
insight: Prioritizing good sleep directly reduces your cravings and strengthens your recovery.

title: Why Should I Take My Medication?
problem: Does medication really help?
insight: Medication is a powerful tool to support your recovery, not a shortcut around it.

title: The First 72 Hours
problem: You're out, and the first few days feel louder and faster than you expected.
learn_title: The first three days are about survival, not progress
insight: The first 72 hours are not about building a life. They're about staying here to build one.

title: One Person I Can Actually Call
problem: You have a phone full of numbers and nobody you'd call at two in the morning.
learn_title: One reachable person beats a long list
insight: Make the practice call today so the emergency call isn't the first one.

title: Paperwork, ID, and the Appointments That Matter
problem: There's a stack of things you're supposed to do and no order to any of it.
insight: Missed appointments cost more than the appointment. Show up even when you show up badly.

title: The People and Places I'm Walking Back Into
problem: The same street, the same numbers in your phone, the same people at the door.
learn_title: Old cues fire before you decide anything
insight: Decide what you'll do before the moment decides for you.

title: Sixteen Hours With Nothing In Them
problem: Inside, the day was decided for you. Out here it's wide open, and that's worse than it sounds.
learn_title: Empty time is a risk factor, not a break
insight: Decide what tomorrow looks like tonight, before the empty hours get a vote.

title: My Tolerance Is Not What It Was
problem: Part of you thinks you can use the same amount you used before.
learn_title: Tolerance drops fast, and it doesn't warn you
insight: Your tolerance reset. Your plan has to reset with it.

title: Everything At Once
problem: Noise, choices, people, phones. You're out, and you feel worse than you expected to.
learn_title: Overwhelm after release is normal and it's temporary
insight: Feeling wrecked in the first weeks isn't a relapse warning by itself. Hiding it is.

title: The Urge That's Here Right Now
problem: It's not a someday craving. It's here, in your chest, right now.
learn_title: An urge is a wave, not a verdict
insight: You don't have to beat the craving. You have to be somewhere else when it peaks.

title: When Surviving Stops Being the Whole Job
problem: The emergency is easing off, and you're not sure what you're supposed to be doing now.
learn_title: Stabilizing is the doorway, not the destination
insight: Surviving got you here. It won't be enough to keep you here.

title: Somewhere Safe to Sleep
problem: Where you're staying isn't settled, or it's a place you know isn't good for you.
learn_title: Where you sleep decides most of the rest
insight: A safe bed isn't a luxury step. It's the step everything else stands on.

title: How Do I Ask for Help?
problem: What do I actually say?
insight: Be clear, specific, and direct when you ask for help.

title: How Do I Find a Sponsor?
problem: How do I ask someone?
insight: Be direct when you ask someone to be your sponsor.

title: How Do I Learn to Trust Again?
problem: How do I let people in?
learn_title: Build Trust, One Step at a Time
insight: Building trust starts small, with yourself and then with others, through consistent honest actions.

title: My Weekly Recovery Plan.
problem: How do I keep this going?
learn_title: Plan Your Week, Build Your Support
insight: Consistently planning your week helps you stay connected to your recovery and the people who support it.

title: What Does a Peer Recovery Specialist Do?
problem: How can a peer help me?
insight: Your peer recovery specialist is there to offer specific support because they understand your experience.

title: What Does Recovery Look Like This Week?
problem: What's my week going to look like?
insight: Plan your recovery activities on your calendar each week to stay on track.

title: What Really Happens at a Meeting?
problem: What should I expect?
insight: Knowing what to expect can make taking that first step much easier.

title: Which Recovery Meeting Is Right for Me?
problem: Which meeting should I try?
insight: Exploring different meeting types and trying a few will help you find the best fit for your recovery journey.

title: Who Should Be on My Recovery Team?
problem: Who belongs on my team?
insight: Build your team and know how to reach each person when you need them.

title: Why Can't I Do This Alone?
problem: Why does connection matter so much?
insight: Real connection is your strongest shield against relapse.

title: Building My Relationship Plan.
problem: How do I keep relationships healthy?
insight: Your relationship plan helps you navigate tough moments and keep your connections strong.

title: Can People Trust Me Again?
problem: Is trust even possible?
learn_title: Trust Comes From What You Do
insight: Trust is rebuilt through your actions and the small promises you consistently keep.

title: How Can I Be the Parent I Want to Be?
problem: How do I show up for my kids?
insight: Your consistent presence and honesty are the most powerful gifts you can give your children.

title: How Can I Repair Family Relationships?
problem: How do I start fixing things?
insight: Your family needs to see consistent action, not just hear words, to start rebuilding trust.

title: How Do I Communicate Better?
problem: How do I say what I mean?
insight: Say what you mean using 'I' statements and listen carefully to the other person.

title: How Do I Forgive Myself?
problem: Can I let go of the guilt?
learn_title: Let Go of Guilt, Not Accountability
insight: You can acknowledge your past actions without letting them define who you are now.

title: How Do I Make Things Right?
problem: How do I make amends?
insight: True amends show up as changed behavior, not just words.

title: How Do I Set Healthy Boundaries?
problem: How do I say no?
insight: A boundary protects you and your relationships, not just from others but also from your own old habits.

title: What Makes a Healthy Friendship?
problem: Who is safe to be around?
insight: Your true friends will always respect your choices and support your recovery, no matter what.

title: When Should I Walk Away?
problem: How do I know it's time?
insight: If a relationship puts your recovery at risk, you might need to step away, even if it's just for a while.

title: How Can Helping Others Help Me?
problem: Why does service work?
insight: Helping someone else can be the most direct way to get out of your own head and feel better about yourself.

title: How Do I Give Back?
problem: What can I offer my community?
insight: Start with small, sustainable acts of kindness that you can consistently offer.

title: How Do I Protect Everything I've Built?
problem: How do I not lose this?
insight: Protect your recovery by actively guarding your sleep, your people, and your schedule, and by regularly reviewing your plan.

title: How Do I Stay in Recovery?
problem: How do I keep this going long-term?
insight: True recovery isn't a destination; it's a daily commitment you actively maintain.

title: How Does Sponsorship Change Recovery?
problem: What changes with a sponsor?
insight: Sponsorship offers structure, truth, and a deeper commitment to your own recovery by helping others.

title: How Far Have I Come?
problem: What have I actually done?
insight: Your past successes are real proof of your strength and dedication.

title: How Should I Celebrate My Progress?
problem: How do I mark milestones?
insight: Acknowledge every step you take in your recovery, and celebrate it sober with your support network.

title: My Lifelong Recovery Plan.
problem: What's my forever plan?
insight: Your lifelong recovery plan is a living document that guides you through challenges and celebrates your progress.

title: What Do I Do When Life Gets Hard Again?
problem: What about the next crisis?
insight: Anticipate that hard times will return and have a plan ready to put into action.

title: Why Should I Keep Going to Meetings?
problem: Do I still need meetings?
learn_title: Meetings Keep You Strong and Connected
insight: Meetings are a foundation for staying connected and honest in your recovery.

title: How Are My Mental Health and Recovery Connected?
problem: Why do both need care?
learn_title: Mental Health and Recovery Go Together
insight: Your mental health and your recovery are deeply linked, so addressing both is essential for lasting change.

title: Understanding My Recovery Story.
problem: What's my story so far?
insight: Your past doesn't define your future, but understanding it helps you write a new story.

title: What Am I Really Running From?
problem: What's underneath this?
insight: Understanding the pain your substance use covers helps take away its power.

title: What Happens While My Brain Is Healing?
problem: Will I ever feel normal?
insight: Healing your brain takes time, and feeling off is a normal part of that journey.

title: What Is HALT Trying to Tell Me?
problem: Why do I feel off?
insight: Your body uses HALT to signal when a craving is more than just an urge.

title: What Keeps Triggering Me?
problem: What sets me off?
learn_title: Your Triggers and How to Plan
insight: Knowing your triggers allows you to create a plan and stay in control of your recovery.

title: Why Are My Cravings So Strong?
problem: What's happening in my body?
insight: Cravings are temporary and most will peak and pass within 20 minutes.

title: Why Can't I Stop Thinking About Using?
problem: Why won't these thoughts leave?
insight: A thought about using is not a command to use.

title: Why Do I Keep Repeating the Same Pattern?
problem: Why does this keep happening?
insight: Recognize the trigger, the habit, and the payoff to change your patterns.

title: Why Does Stress Make Me Want to Use?
problem: Why does stress hit so hard?
learn_title: Stress and Your Urge to Use
insight: Stress chemicals in your body make your brain look for fast relief, which often means wanting to use.

title: Building My Relapse Prevention Plan.
problem: What's my full plan?
insight: Your prevention plan is your personal guide when urges hit hard.

title: How Do I Celebrate Small Wins?
problem: Why does celebrating matter?
insight: Recognizing and acknowledging your small wins trains your brain to value your recovery efforts.

title: How Do I Get Through High-Risk Situations?
problem: How do I handle risky places?
insight: Plan ahead for risky places by knowing how you'll leave and who you'll bring.

title: How Do I Know I'm Slipping?
problem: What are my warning signs?
insight: Your warning signs are personal alerts, giving you a chance to intervene before a slip becomes a relapse.

title: How Do I Start Again?
problem: How do I come back?
insight: Starting over is a decision you make to protect your recovery.

title: What Happens Before a Relapse?
problem: What's the chain of events?
insight: Understanding the stages of relapse gives you specific points where you can intervene effectively.

title: What If I Slip?
problem: What do I do right after?
learn_title: After a Slip: Safety and Honesty
insight: Your immediate safety and honest communication are your most powerful tools after a slip.

title: What Should I Do When My Thoughts Change?
problem: What if I start romanticizing using?
learn_title: When Romantic Thoughts About Using Start
insight: Talking out loud about romantic thoughts of using helps to disarm them.

title: When Should I Ask for Help?
problem: How do I know it's time?
insight: If you're asking if you need help, the answer is always yes.

title: Which Recovery Tools Work Best for Me?
problem: What actually works for me?
insight: Regularly check in with yourself to see if your recovery tools are still serving you effectively.
